issues.failure_explanation: The exact projection (eq: exact projection) is an orthogonal sum of 1+d pieces: the S*_k-block piece plus one summand per mode k in [d]. The proof keeps only the C-piece and the summands with k∈[d]\I (its auxiliary estimates are stated 'for all k∈I'), so only 1+|I| of the 1+d orthogonal pieces are bounded by M = ||A×_{k∉I}P_{u_k}||. The final step ||P_T A||² ≤ (|I|+1)M² is therefore unjustified; the displayed estimates support at most ||approj(A)||² ≥ c_I/(1+d) · ||P_T A||², i.e. the constant sqrt(c_I/(d+1)), not the stated sqrt(c_I/(|I|+1)).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the stated constant by \tilde\omega(\tensX)=\sqrt{\frac{1}{d+1}\prod_{k\in I}\frac{r_k-\underline r_k}{\min\{n_k,n_{-k}\}}} and bound the k∉I summands of ||P_T A||² by the same chain already displayed; all downstream statements then hold with the adjusted constants.
issues.overall_effect: The specific angle constant 	ilde\omega(X) claimed in Proposition prop: angle condition GRAP (and propagated into the Armijo bound (eq: Armijo GRAP) and the sufficient-decrease analysis) is unsupported whenever |I| < d; the angle condition itself survives with the smaller constant sqrt(c_I/(d+1)), so convergence conclusions survive with rescaled constants.
issues.title: Angle-condition constant of the approximate projection is not established
issues.why_classification: A one-symbol constant correction plus a routine re-use of the already-displayed estimate for the omitted summands; the angle condition, its role, and every downstream guarantee survive with adjusted constants.

issues.failure_explanation: The s⁴-group of the expansion contains the d one-dot C-terms AND the d(d−1) two-dot terms ||G×_j u̇_j ×_k u̇_k||², each of size ‖V‖²/σ_min² (since ||u̇_k|| ≤ ‖V‖/σ_min and ||G×_j u̇_j|| ≤ ‖V‖). The displayed bound allots only binom(d,1)=d terms of that size at order s⁴ (and similarly undercounts at every higher order), so the inequality '≤ s⁴ Σ_k binom(d,k) s^{2k−2}‖V‖^{2k+2}/σ^{2k}' does not follow from the displayed expansion; the stated c(X)=(1/σ_min²+1)^{d/2} is not established by this proof.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Re-derive the bound with the correct count, e.g. ||·||² ≤ s⁴||V||⁴·d²·Σ_k binom(d,k)(s||V||/σ_min)^{2k} ≤ s⁴||V||⁴·d²(1/σ_min²+1)^d, and carry the enlarged constant c(X) through Proposition prop: backtracking GRAP and the convergence proof.
issues.overall_effect: The curvature constant c(X) entering the stepsize lower bound of Proposition prop: backtracking GRAP and the sufficient-decrease analysis is unsupported as stated; all downstream convergence claims survive only with a correspondingly enlarged (rank-dependent) constant, which shrinks the certified stepsize lower bound but keeps it positive.
issues.title: Curvature bound's final constant undercounts the second-type cross terms
issues.why_classification: Only the constant in a helper bound is wrong; enlarging c(X) by a dimension-dependent factor preserves every substantive claim, rate type, and guarantee downstream, with no new construction.

issues.failure_explanation: The derived decrease at the candidate is a·ω̃²·‖V_{X_r}‖²·s̲ with s̲ ≥ min{ρ(1−a)/ā, ρs̄} and ‖V_{X_r}‖² ≥ ¼‖∇f(X̲)‖²·∏_k c_k, giving a decrease of order ‖∇f(X̲)‖²·∏c_k·min{…, ρs̄}. The defined δ(X̲) instead carries ‖∇f(X̲)‖ (first power), ∏c_k (first power), and a min containing the terms 'ρ' and '2ρ/(3‖∇f(X̲)‖)' in place of ρs̄. The displayed chain therefore needs both ‖∇f(X̲)‖·∏c_k ≥ 1 and s̄ ≥ min{1, 2/(3‖∇f(X̲)‖)}; neither is assumed or proved (the standing hypothesis only gives s̄ ≤ min{1, 1/‖V_X‖}). So the step f(Y_r) ≤ f(X_r) − 3δ(X̲), and hence f(Y) ≤ f(X) − δ(X̲), does not follow from the displayed estimates.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Rescale the exhibited δ(X̲) to the quantity the estimates actually yield — δ = (aω̃²/12)‖∇f(X̲)‖²·∏_k c_k²·min{ρ(1−a)/ā(X̲), ρs̄} — and correspondingly replace the min-terms 'ρ' and '2ρ/(3‖∇f(X̲)‖)' by ρs̄ throughout the chain; all subsequent steps and Theorem thm: GRAP-R then go through unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The sufficient-decrease constant exhibited in Case 2 (all modes rank-deficient accumulation points) of Proposition prop: GRAP-R decrease is unsupported, so the apocalypse-free convergence Theorem thm: GRAP-R, which consumes this decrease condition, is unproven as written for accumulation points of that type.
issues.title: Case 2 of the GRAP-R sufficient-decrease proof does not validate the exhibited δ(X)
issues.why_classification: The repair is a definitional rescaling of the (existentially chosen) δ together with carrying s̄ in the min; the proposition remains true with the same proof structure and all substantive guarantees survive.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: By using~\cref{prop: rfGRAP}, we can prove that the rfGRAP-R method is apocalypse-free in a same fashion as~\cref{thm: GRAP-R}.

issues.failure_explanation: Two defects. (i) Scope: Proposition prop: rfGRAP is stated only for full-rank accumulation points (X̲ ∈ M_r), yet Theorem thm:added-1's contradiction argument applies the one-step decrease at the accumulation point X̲, which may be rank deficient — exactly the apocalypse-prone regime the theorem claims to exclude; no stated result covers that case, so the theorem's proof uses the proposition outside its hypotheses. (ii) The proof's rank-deficient Case 2 does not validate its own δ: from the branch estimates one gets ‖V_{X_r}‖ ≥ (√c_I/2)·∏_k min{k}^{−1/2}·‖V̂_X̲‖ and, using ω̂² ≥ (1/(d+1))∏_k 1/min_k, ‖V̂_X̲‖ ≥ (1/√(d+1))·∏_k min_k^{−1/2}·‖V_X̲‖; the displayed chain omits the √(d+1) factor, so the exhibited δ(X̲) = (a·s̲/12(d+1))·∏_k c_I/min_k²·‖V_X̲‖² exceeds the derivable decrease by the factor √(d+1)·∏_k min{n_k,n_{−k}} ≥ 1.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must extend Proposition prop: rfGRAP's statement to all X̲ ∈ M_{≤r} with ‖V_X̲‖ ≠ 0 and redo its Case 2 so the exhibited δ(X̲) is bounded by the derived Armijo decrease (the chain via Lemma lem: inequality and the angle condition gives ‖V_{X_breve r}‖ ≥ (√c_I/(2√(d+1)))·∏_k min_k^{−1/2}·‖V_X̲‖-type bounds, and δ must be rescaled accordingly); the resulting statement must cover mixed-rank (rank-deficient) accumulation points for Theorem thm:added-1's telescoping argument to apply.
issues.overall_effect: The apocalypse-free guarantee for the rfGRAP-R method (Theorem thm:added-1, and the abstract/introductory claims that both proposed methods converge to stationary points) is unsupported at rank-deficient accumulation points; only convergence to full-rank stationary points is substantiated for rfGRAP-R.
issues.title: rfGRAP-R convergence lacks a validated rank-deficient sufficient-decrease condition
issues.why_classification: The source contains the template for the needed rank-deficient analysis (Case 3 of prop: GRAP-R decrease) and the failed steps are quantitative, so a contained nontrivial repair (restate the proposition over M_{≤r} and fix the constant chain) preserves the advertised apocalypse-free guarantee; no essentially new proof architecture is required, but the repair is more than a local routine edit.
